label: Selected C — Counterpair
tagline: An icon library for discovery. A workbench for accountable releases.
brief: Preserve the chosen two-piece silhouette and build a quiet, usable identity for designers, developers and design-system teams. The website, README and platform examples in this deck are illustrative brand placements, not a statement of released functionality.
criteria: One-colour first; readable small; genuine transparent counters; outlined type; light and dark parity. Black and white dominate, with burgundy used sparingly.

concepts.name: Counterpair
concepts.idea: Two independent forms become one recognisable signature.
rationale: The chosen two-piece asymmetry is preserved; no generic cube, sparkle or AI motif.
A restrained title-case wordmark balances the assertive symbol. The F shoulder is redrawn and all letters are outlined.
Separate standard, reverse and small-size drawings address weight and counter clarity.
Possible numeral-5 reading remains a known risk; build name association rather than inventing a literal story.

recommendation: C is the selected logo direction. This kit lives in the Glyph Workbench; production has not been changed. Use the supplied masters instead of recreating the mark.
next_steps: Review the identity in the Workbench pages 07–09.
Complete a professional trademark/name and reverse-image search before a public identity rollout.
Physically proof any print application; CMYK values are starting conversions, not certified matches.
Approve a separate implementation step before replacing live application assets.
